about: R-rop-10 has the first stage's verification measure whether a reference file read twice in one session costs twice, in one session chaining two commands; this repository never runs chained commands (R-adf-5). Sal directed that the measurement be deferred to when chaining is put to real use.
question: Should R-rop-10's repeated-read measurement leave stage conditional-steps and be answered when chaining is first used in earnest?
